final: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), side_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(s.order_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM side_counts AS s CROSS JOIN side_average AS a WHERE s.order_count > a.avg_count
